reason_code_checkpoints_by_domain.name: reason_code_checkpoints_by_domain
reason_code_checkpoints_by_domain.value: ("reason_code"."domain" = 'RECIPIENT_CONTACT' AND "reason_code"."valid_checkpoints" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("reason_code"."valid_checkpoints") >= 1 AND "reason_code"."valid_checkpoints" <@ ARRAY['PRE_DISPATCH', 'NEXT_STOP', 'DOORSTEP']::text[]) OR ("reason_code"."domain" <> 'RECIPIENT_CONTACT' AND "reason_code"."valid_checkpoints" IS NULL)

reason_code_operations_by_domain.name: reason_code_operations_by_domain
reason_code_operations_by_domain.value: ("reason_code"."domain" IN ('SESSION_REVOCATION', 'STAFF_PROFILE_REJECTION', 'STAFF_MFA_RESET', 'CREDENTIAL_ADMINISTRATION', 'RIDER_DEVICE_REPLACEMENT', 'RIDER_DEVICE_REVOCATION') AND "reason_code"."permitted_operations" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("reason_code"."permitted_operations") >= 1 AND "reason_code"."permitted_operations"::text ~ '^\{[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(#[A-Z][A-Z_]*)?(,[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(#[A-Z][A-Z_]*)?)*\}$') OR ("reason_code"."domain" NOT IN ('SESSION_REVOCATION', 'STAFF_PROFILE_REJECTION', 'STAFF_MFA_RESET', 'CREDENTIAL_ADMINISTRATION', 'RIDER_DEVICE_REPLACEMENT', 'RIDER_DEVICE_REVOCATION') AND "reason_code"."permitted_operations" IS NULL)

audit_event_structured_are_objects.name: audit_event_structured_are_objects
audit_event_structured_are_objects.value:
("audit_event"."device_context" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("audit_event"."device_context") = 'object')
        AND ("audit_event"."before_after" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("audit_event"."before_after") = 'object')
        AND ("audit_event"."related_ids" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("audit_event"."related_ids") = 'object')
        AND jsonb_typeof("audit_event"."detail") = 'object'

idempotency_record_answer_when_completed.name: idempotency_record_answer_when_completed
idempotency_record_answer_when_completed.value:
("idempotency_record"."state" = 'COMPLETED' AND "idempotency_record"."response_status" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_record"."response_body" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_record"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("idempotency_record"."state" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "idempotency_record"."response_status" IS NULL AND "idempotency_record"."response_body" IS NULL AND "idempotency_record"."completed_at" IS NULL)

idempotency_record_sealed_is_whole.name: idempotency_record_sealed_is_whole
idempotency_record_sealed_is_whole.value:
("idempotency_record"."sealed_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("idempotency_record"."sealed_nonce" IS NULL)
        AND ("idempotency_record"."sealed_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("idempotency_record"."sealed_key_version" IS NULL)
        AND ("idempotency_record"."sealed_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("idempotency_record"."sealed_envelope_version" IS NULL)
        AND ("idempotency_record"."sealed_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("idempotency_record"."sealed_expires_at" IS NULL)

credential_delivery_job_queued_is_untouc.name: credential_delivery_job_queued_is_untouched
credential_delivery_job_queued_is_untouc.value: "credential_delivery_job"."state" <> 'QUEUED' OR ("credential_delivery_job"."attempt_count" = 0 AND "credential_delivery_job"."deferred_claims" = 0 AND "credential_delivery_job"."lease_version" = 0 AND "credential_delivery_job"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" IS NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."accepted_at" IS NULL)

credential_delivery_job_lease_when_lease.name: credential_delivery_job_lease_when_leased
credential_delivery_job_lease_when_lease.value: "credential_delivery_job"."state" <> 'LEASED' OR ("credential_delivery_job"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."lease_version" >= 1 AND "credential_delivery_job"."attempt_count" >= 1)

credential_delivery_job_accepted_when_ac.name: credential_delivery_job_accepted_when_accepted
credential_delivery_job_accepted_when_ac.value: ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'ACCEPTED') = ("credential_delivery_job"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("credential_delivery_job"."provider_message_ref" IS NULL OR "credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'ACCEPTED')

credential_delivery_job_provider_fields_.name: credential_delivery_job_provider_fields_bounded
credential_delivery_job_provider_fields_.value: length("credential_delivery_job"."provider_dedupe_id") BETWEEN 16 AND 128 AND ("credential_delivery_job"."provider_message_ref" IS NULL OR length("credential_delivery_job"."provider_message_ref") BETWEEN 1 AND 256)

credential_delivery_job_payload_is_whole.name: credential_delivery_job_payload_is_whole
credential_delivery_job_payload_is_whole.value: ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_nonce" IS NULL) AND ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_key_version" IS NULL) AND ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_envelope_version" IS NULL)

credential_delivery_job_payload_follows_.name: credential_delivery_job_payload_follows_state
credential_delivery_job_payload_follows_.value: ("credential_delivery_job"."state" IN ('QUEUED', 'LEASED', 'RETRYABLE') AND "credential_delivery_job"."payload_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."payload_erased_at" IS NULL) OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" IN ('ACCEPTED', 'FAILED', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED') AND "credential_delivery_job"."payload_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."payload_erased_at" IS NOT NULL)

credential_delivery_job_outcome_follows_.name: credential_delivery_job_outcome_follows_state
credential_delivery_job_outcome_follows_.value:
("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'QUEUED' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" IS NULL)
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'LEASED')
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'RETRYABLE' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" IN ('UNKNOWN', 'RELINQUISHED', 'REDEMPTION_UNCONFIRMED', 'PAYLOAD_DEFERRED'))
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'ACCEPTED' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" = 'ACCEPTED')
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'FAILED' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" IN ('REJECTED', 'DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED', 'SCHEDULE_EXHAUSTED', 'PAYLOAD_UNREADABLE'))
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'EXPIRED' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" = 'EXPIRED')
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'CANCELLED' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" = 'CANCELLED')

session_policy_revision_by_principal.name: session_policy_revision_by_principal
session_policy_revision_by_principal.value:
("session"."principal_type" = 'STAFF' AND "session"."policy_revision" IS NULL)
        OR ("session"."principal_type" IN ('VENDOR', 'RIDER') AND "session"."policy_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."policy_revision" >= 1)

staff_identity_email_shape.name: staff_identity_email_shape
staff_identity_email_shape.value:
length("staff_identity"."work_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320
        AND length("staff_identity"."work_email_canonical") BETWEEN 3 AND 320
        AND "staff_identity"."work_email_canonical" = btrim("staff_identity"."work_email_canonical")

staff_identity_credential_whole.name: staff_identity_credential_whole
staff_identity_credential_whole.value:
("staff_identity"."credential_hash" IS NULL) = ("staff_identity"."credential_established_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("staff_identity"."credential_hash" IS NULL) = ("staff_identity"."credential_generation" = 0)
